title: selectAdjacentShape('prev') with no selection picks the second-to-last shape
reason: Repeats #10559's no-selection previous-navigation index report; the sole comment confirms PR #10601 covers both issues.
assessment: This is an upstream duplicate of #10559, and Varve intentionally leaves Tab available for browser focus navigation when no canvas node is selected; no local selectAdjacentShape API has the reported index path.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream duplicate of #10559, and Varve intentionally leaves Tab available for browser focus navigation when no canvas node is selected; no local selectAdjacentShape API has the reported index path.

title: getSvgPathData permanently rounds a geometry's stored points to two decimals
reason: Reports tldraw geometry methods calling mutating Vec.toFixed() while generating SVG path strings; a comment says a PR was opened to remove those calls and add regressions.
assessment: Varve does not use the cited mutable Vec geometry primitive or `getSvgPathData` methods for cached shape geometry. Its scene points are plain immutable-by-convention records and path serialization does not share the reported mutating call site.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use the cited mutable Vec geometry primitive or `getSvgPathData` methods for cached shape geometry. Its scene points are plain immutable-by-convention records and path serialization does not share the reported mutating call site.

title: Group2d.transform drops ignored children and geometry options
reason: Reports an upstream Group2d transform omitting ignored children, flags, and transform options; the comment says PR #10603 fixes those omissions.
assessment: Varve scene grouping is represented by document node hierarchies and affine transforms, not the upstream `Geometry2d`/`Group2d` primitive. The reported debug-geometry and transform-option loss has no matching local transform method.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve scene grouping is represented by document node hierarchies and affine transforms, not the upstream `Geometry2d`/`Group2d` primitive. The reported debug-geometry and transform-option loss has no matching local transform method.

title: Context menu stops reopening after left-click dismiss with radix-ui 1.5.x
reason: Reports a reproduction tied to a newer radix-ui version and proposes controlled-root compatibility or a narrower dependency range. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not depend on the cited radix-ui context-menu package/version range or use its root component for the canvas context menu, so this dependency regression cannot affect the current path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not depend on the cited radix-ui context-menu package/version range or use its root component for the canvas context menu, so this dependency regression cannot affect the current path.

title: License key with non-ASCII payload fails verification with Invalid signature
reason: Reports a signing/verifying encoding disagreement for non-ASCII tldraw SDK license-key payloads, with existing ASCII keys as a compatibility concern. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no signed license-key mint/verification pipeline accepting arbitrary payload text, so the Latin-1 versus UTF-8 signature mismatch is outside its current product surface.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no signed license-key mint/verification pipeline accepting arbitrary payload text, so the Latin-1 versus UTF-8 signature mismatch is outside its current product surface.

title: Reduce the tldraw bundle size
reason: A measured SDK bundle-size plan covers tree shaking, lazy rich text, dependency removal, and size budgets; the comment records the results and blockers of linked PRs #10573–#10575.
assessment: The report concerns the published tldraw SDK barrel and its tree-shaking/chunking contract. Varve is a multi-app workspace with native/wasm consumers and package boundaries that require its own measured bundle budgets; these upstream numbers do not identify a local regression.

varveAssessment.assessment: The report concerns the published tldraw SDK barrel and its tree-shaking/chunking contract. Varve is a multi-app workspace with native/wasm consumers and package boundaries that require its own measured bundle budgets; these upstream numbers do not identify a local regression.

title: Rename the shared render pipeline internals from thumbnail to screenshot
reason: Requests internal screenshot naming for a hosted shared pipeline serving both OG thumbnails and MCP shape-cluster captures while keeping wire-visible names stable; the comment agrees and defers to a dependency landing.
assessment: The shared edge render job and MCP cluster-capture service are hosted tldraw infrastructure, not Varve's local scene renderer. No matching naming-only change is warranted in Varve's distinct render pipeline.

varveAssessment.assessment: The shared edge render job and MCP cluster-capture service are hosted tldraw infrastructure, not Varve's local scene renderer. No matching naming-only change is warranted in Varve's distinct render pipeline.

title: Connecting to shared whiteboard, note text issue
reason: Reports guest collaborators' note edits being rejected/rolled back; one commenter offers to reproduce and investigate, while the later comment says #10824 fixed signed-out guest note attribution and asks whether signed-in users still reproduce it.
assessment: Varve has no shared whiteboard collaboration sessions or remote note-attribution permission path, so this incident and guest-specific upstream fix are outside the local-first product boundary.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no shared whiteboard collaboration sessions or remote note-attribution permission path, so this incident and guest-specific upstream fix are outside the local-first product boundary.

title: Arrow labels wrap and get cut off in PNG exports
reason: Reports an arrow label that appears single-line on canvas but wraps/clips in PNG; the sole comment requests the source file or Mermaid text and asks whether SVG or a retyped/nudged label also reproduces.
assessment: Varve shares canonical text layout data between editor rendering and export paths, but this tldraw report has no reproducible source artifact and may involve its Mermaid-generated arrow label. Keep it as a cross-rendering parity check, not a confirmed Varve defect.

title: Tighten file.owningGroupId to non-optional in the client schema
reason: Requests a hosted client nullability change after a Postgres migration, but the issue documents replication-staleness risks and unresolved access-check guards; the comment says to wait for deployment and guidance.
assessment: Varve does not have the cited dotcom shared-file Postgres schema or remote owner-group access checks; the migration sequencing question is specific to upstream hosted infrastructure.
